$schema_note: Schema per memory-map skill: {core, regions[], peripherals[]}. Extended with tiers[]/masters[]/interrupts[]/reserved[] to faithfully capture the 3-tier AMBA (AXI4-Lite / AHB3-Lite / APB) layout defined in 01_ARCHITECTURE.md §2-3. All addresses/sizes sourced from ARCHITECTURE.md §3.1-3.3 and §7 (IRQ map) — no invented addresses.

core.trap_addr_note: PROGADDR_IRQ architecture default (ARCHITECTURE.md §4); firmware places its vector table here
core.irq_line: single aggregated line onto picorv32 irq[3]; irq[2:0] and irq[31:4] tied off (ARCHITECTURE.md §4, §7)

masters: M1: MOD-15 boot-copy engine (boot-time only, quiesced post-boot)
tiers.interconnect: MOD-02 alexforencich verilog-axi axil_crossbar/axil_interconnect (2 masters x 3 slaves v1)
tiers.default_responder: unmapped AXI address space returns verilog-axi default responder error/zero

masters: M0: MOD-03 AXI-Lite->AHB bridge (sole AHB master)
tiers.parent_window: sits entirely inside AXI4-Lite window 0x40000000, size 0x00100000 (1 MB)

masters: M0: MOD-04 AHB->APB bridge (sole APB master)
tiers.interconnect: MOD-04 decodes low 16 bits of incoming AHB address to 12 psel lines (AR-1)
tiers.parent_window: sits entirely inside AHB3-Lite window 0x40002000, size 0x0000C000 (48 kB, per AR-1)

regions.name: MOD-05_SRAM_16kB
regions.notes: OpenRAM 8x2kB 1-port macros, AXI4-Lite-to-SRAM wrapper. Boot target; PROGADDR_RESET = 0x00000000.

regions.name: MOD-03_AXI_AHB_bridge_window
regions.notes: 1 MB window; all AHB/AHB-behind-APB devices decode inside this window (see ahb_regions below). Only 0x0000C000 of the 1 MB is actually populated (MOD-06+MOD-07+MOD-04 fanout) — remainder is reserved.

regions.name: MOD-15_AXI4L_sys_regs
regions.notes: Bridge config, chip ID, debug — CPU-side, not APB. Also where MOD-15's cross-tier PMU status is exposed at the AXI tier.

ahb_regions.name: MOD-06_Metering_DSP
ahb_regions.notes: Sample ingress FIFO (stream) + result/status burst regs, <=8 in-band (REQ-040, tiering exception rule §2.1.4)

ahb_regions.name: MOD-07_CAN_2.0B_FIFO
ahb_regions.notes: TX/RX frame FIFOs (stream) + SJA1000-class control/status/interrupt/acceptance/timing regs, <=8 in-band, kept on AHB per §2.1.4 exception

ahb_regions.name: MOD-04_AHB_APB_bridge_window
ahb_regions.notes: APB tier fan-out window; contains all 12 APB peripheral slots below, base 0x40002000 through 0x4000DFFF inclusive.

peripherals.name: MOD-10_SPI1_flash
peripherals.ip: EF_SPI (REUSE_INTERNAL); boot-time SPI1 access instead uses MOD-15's bit-banged FSM, this peripheral is post-boot only

peripherals.name: MOD-13_PWM32
peripherals.ip: EF_PWM32 (REUSE_INTERNAL, index gap A1); fallback EF_TMR32 PWM mode occupies same slot 0x8000 if unqualified

peripherals.name: MOD-15_PMU_INTC_bootctrl
peripherals.ip: CREATE (small); also owns CLK_GATE_EN bits (REQ-035) and IRQ aggregator (IRQ_EN/IRQ_PEND) at this slot; cross-tier module also present at AXI S2 (0x7F000000) and as AXI master M1

peripherals.name: MOD-16_SAR_ADC_comparator_ctrl
peripherals.irq_note: IRQ 12 = SAR ADC conversion done, IRQ 13 = comparator (zero-cross) edge
peripherals.ip: BLACKBOX analog wrapper (BB-02 SAR ADC 12b, BB-03 comparator x1-2)

reserved.name: AXI_gap_post_SRAM
reserved.note: Unmapped between SRAM (16 kB) and the AXI->AHB bridge window; default responder returns error/zero

reserved.name: AXI_gap_post_bridge_window
reserved.note: Unmapped between the 1 MB AXI->AHB bridge window and MOD-15 AXI sys regs

reserved.name: AXI_gap_post_sysregs
reserved.note: Unmapped tail of 32-bit AXI address space above MOD-15 sys regs

reserved.name: AHB_bridge_window_unused_tail
reserved.note: Portion of the 1 MB AXI->AHB bridge window (0x40000000-0x40100000) not consumed by the 3 populated AHB slave windows (MOD-06 4kB + MOD-07 4kB + MOD-04 48kB = 56 kB used of 1 MB)

reserved.name: APB_bridge_window_headroom
reserved.note: ARCHITECTURE.md §3.4 states the AHB->APB bridge region as [0x40002000, 0x40010000) = 0xE000 (56 kB), but AR-1 (§3.2) explicitly derives the downstream APB range as 0x40002000-0x4000DFFF = 0xC000 (48 kB), matching the 12x4kB APB slots exactly and stated twice as '48 kB'. This 8 kB span (0x4000E000-0x40010000) reconciles the two statements: treated here as reserved headroom within the bridge's low-16-bit pass-through decode, not as populated APB slots. Flagged per instruction not to silently re-interpret; escalate to architecture owner if this reading is wrong.

unpopulated_masters.name: MOD-17 optional 1-channel DMA
unpopulated_masters.status: reserved, unpopulated in v1 (deferred per REQ-058)

sanity_checks.no_overlaps: Verified: AXI regions [0x0,0x4000), [0x40000000,0x40100000), [0x7F000000,0x7F001000) are pairwise disjoint. AHB regions [0x40000000,0x40001000), [0x40001000,0x40002000), [0x40002000,0x4000E000) are disjoint and contiguous. APB 12 slots [0x40002000+n*0x1000, +0x1000) for n=0..11 are disjoint and contiguous, exactly filling [0x40002000,0x4000E000).
sanity_checks.known_source_discrepancy: See reserved[].APB_bridge_window_headroom note — ARCHITECTURE.md §3.4 arithmetic (0x40010000) does not match AR-1's explicit 48 kB derivation (0x4000E000); this file uses the AR-1 value as authoritative since it is stated twice and matches the 12x4kB peripheral count exactly.

deviation_note: analog_manifest.json was NOT generated in this run: the task instructions explicitly restricted output to only this file (02_memory_map.json) and forbade writing to any other path, which supersedes the memory-map skill's normal instruction to also emit analog_manifest.json. Per ARCHITECTURE.md §8.16/REQ-048, this project is not all-digital (MOD-16 = BLACKBOX, SAR ADC + 1-2 comparators, 2 of <=3 analog blocks used, PLL BB-04 not instantiated in v1) so analog_manifest.json's blocks[] would be non-empty, not blocks:[] -- Stage AMS would be dispatched. This should be generated as a separate, explicitly-authorized write.
